artifacts.role: Pinned experiment source and protocol patch

conditions.development_effort: Offline build durations in linked build record. Active effort and AI costs unmeasured.

cache_capacity.reason: No cache format or context limit change.

communication.reason: Counts accepted logical tokens and scores. AXI polling/physical bandwidth unmeasured.

idle_subtracted_energy.reason: Gross is primary. Retain signed values in raw artifacts.
sources: Signed incremental_j in raw alignment results

long_stability.reason: Three short matched pairs, no long-run claim.

memory.reason: Original model/cache arithmetic is fixed. Candidate adds two 256 × 9-bit buffers. Host peak memory is unmeasured.

memory_bandwidth.reason: No actual traffic or stall profiler for this interface comparison.

model_quality.reason: The frozen model and exact numerical rules are unchanged.

operating_conditions.reason: Reported clock verified at gates. Continuous clock/thermal traces unavailable.

sources: All six arm block.json files and candidate cap/compact receipts

prefill.reason: First-output and TTFT boundaries include prefill plus first prediction.

sources: Per-case raw timestamps and three paired summaries

resources.reason: Static reports for the exact routed circuits.

stage_cycles.reason: START-relative first/last useful-byte and done cycles. Internal prefill not separated.

startup.reason: Setup retained separately, no cold-start comparison.

sources: CPU-observed output_ns arrays in each block.json

correctness.evidence: 139,840 diagnostic signed scores matched. Three compact and two cap checks matched. All 36 timed and 18 warm-up requests matched, and the original BOS control and restoration each matched 320 scores.

configuration.final_state: Original firmware and original weights restored, 320 original BOS scores verified

limitations: Three matched pairs on one board and one boot. No long-term, cross-boot or broad reliability claim.
Board-host output observations. No end-client or isolated accelerator latency claim.
VCC_SOM module supply only. Whole-board and FPGA-only energy remain unavailable.
No prefill-only timing, physical bus bandwidth or host peak-memory measurement.
Only legacy diagnostic mode transferred all raw scores. Compact correctness was verified by exact output, stop, context, and count; simulation independently checked local score values.
Raw local evidence is preserved on the Mac. Shared backup remains pending.

protocol.measurement_boundary: Board CPU request admission before encoding/clear through first/last useful byte and stop/drain. Six-request gross VCC_SOM block energy ends after verification. Load, switching, full-score diagnostics and UART export excluded.
protocol.quality_gate: Exact full-score diagnostics and same exact capped and uncapped completions and stops.
protocol.tokenizer: BOS plus two hex digit IDs per input UTF-8 byte. Useful outputs are byte IDs and exclude EOS.
protocol.warmup: Three exact requests per arm with loaded weights.

quality.evidence: Frozen model, arithmetic and greedy output rules unchanged. No broader quality inference.
